About Noor

From film sets to school stages

Noor Khan is a choreographer and celebrity trainer from Navi Mumbai. For more than ten years he has danced and assisted on Bollywood sets with Ganesh Acharya. He is just as at home in a school hall, teaching students their next routine.

He started Dance Desire and NR Institute of Dance around one simple idea: anyone can dance. More than 55,000 students have tested that idea with him, in workshops, classrooms and online sessions.

Lyrical hip-hop is his home ground, but he moves comfortably across eight styles, and he has worked on more than 60 films and video albums along the way.

Read Noor's story →

What Noor does

One choreographer, every kind of stage

From a classroom of first-timers to a corporate gala, the routine is built for the room in front of him.

Dance workshops

Noor has taken his workshops to cities across India. Every room is different, but the first ten minutes are always the same: getting people to stop worrying about looking silly.

Corporate shows and events

Office teams who have never danced together, turned into a show. He keeps the routines simple enough to learn and sharp enough to look good on stage.

School and college annual days

Annual days with a stage full of children and one evening to get it right. Noor plans the theme, sets the routines and makes sure every child knows where to stand.

Electrifying stage presence

When he performs himself, it is the same energy he asks of his students, just with nobody to hide behind.

  • Lyrical hip-hop: Story first, then the groove.
  • Bollywood: Big expressions, bigger finishes.
  • Freestyle: No counts written down, only feel.
  • Hip-hop: Bounce, rock and attitude.
  • Bolly-hop: Filmi melody on a hip-hop beat.
  • Krumping: Raw energy, sharp and loud.
  • Locking and popping: Freezes, hits and clean isolations.
  • Electro house: Fast feet, endless stamina.
